Subject: Exec note: triage findings & proposed mitigations

Quick summary from triage (first 20m):
- Confirmed: p95 up to ~7s; 5xxs peaked ~6% and currently ~4.2%
- Scope: single model variant in us-west region, throughput drop ~28%
- Signals: increased KV cache misses and a rise in small-batch tail latency after a recent kernel selector tweak (deploy 11:40 PST)

Recommendation (30m horizon):
1) Immediate rollback of the kernel selector change for the affected pool to restore baseline execution path (low risk, rollback tested)
2) Enable an additional hot-cache warming policy to reduce prefix miss penalty during warm-up
3) Keep a canary model in place with traffic shifted gradually once baseline recovered

Customer comms (SUGGESTED - send within 30m):
"Prospecta team — we see and are actively addressing an elevated latency and error rate on your /v1/generate traffic affecting a subset of requests. Our engineers have identified a recent runtime kernel selection change as the likely cause; we're rolling that change back now and expect measurable improvement within 20-30 minutes. We'll follow up with a full postmortem and corrective actions. If you require immediate SLA remediation, we can discuss credits after the incident. — Vivek, Redwood"

Please review and let Soojin send the customer-facing note. If we proceed with rollback, coordinate with Ops to schedule a brief maintenance window (max 5 minutes).

- Vivek
VP, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
